employees.label: Employees (headcount)
employees.definition: Employee headcount, rounded to the nearest hundred; an employee is an individual working full time or part time, excluding interns, certain contingent workers and individuals on long-term disability. Shown only for countries with 50+ employees and 10%+ of employees (U.S. and India). Includes Recorded Future from 2025.

employeesOutsideShare.label: Share of employees outside the U.S.
employeesOutsideShare.definition: Approximate share of Mastercard's ~39,800 employees employed outside the U.S., in more than 90 countries (10-K human capital section).

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: We own our corporate headquarters, located in Purchase, New York, and our principal technology and operations center, located in O'Fallon, Missouri.

notes: Mastercard publishes no state-by-state or country-by-country economic footprint. Its 2025 Impact Report (published July 2026) data tables give headcount only for countries with 50+ employees and 10%+ of the workforce (U.S. 11,800; India 9,200; rounded to the nearest hundred) plus 97 countries with employees outside the U.S.; from 2025 the figures include Recorded Future, which the 2024 figures excluded. The FY2025 10-K gives ~70% of ~39,800 employees outside the U.S. and lists no properties beyond the Purchase, NY headquarters and O'Fallon, MO technology center. No taxes-by-country disclosure was found. Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
